name: How do I choose the right contractor for garage drywall and framing repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for garage drywall and framing repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who provides hands-on oversight and handles both the structural carpentry and finish trades. Drywall repairs in garages frequently reveal damaged framing, rotted backing studs, or electrical routing that requires coordinating more than just basic taping. Choosing an owner-operated general contractor like HH Remodeling ensures the person managing your estimate is directly supervising the carpentry, drywall hanging, taping, and finish painting on site. Confirm that the contractor carries proper business accreditation, understands local requirements, and provides a clear plan for both structural repairs and surface blending.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, hands-on contractor who handles framing, drywalling, and finish painting together, ensuring seamless coordination from structural repair to final coat.
